When Do You Need a Dedicated Development Team?

Building an offshore or nearshore dev team is beneficial when you need to:

Reduce Costs and Optimize Budget

Whether it’s changing business priorities, financial constraints, or the need to cut recruiting and back-office expenses, switching to dedicated teams is a cost-effective development strategy

Fill the Expertise Gap

On-site tech teams may lack a specific stack that is hard to find or expensive to acquire locally. Thus, engaging qualified remote experts becomes an effective solution to cover the talent shortage

Focus on Core Business Activities

Delegating the legal, accounting, HR, administrative, and IT infrastructure support to a provider allows businesses to focus on sales, growth and innovation

Accelerate Time-to-Market

Faster staffing allows businesses to kick off and complete development projects sooner. Reasonable fees let companies onboard more skilled professionals who’ll contribute to faster software delivery

Frequently Asked Questions on Hiring Dedicated Development Teams

What is a dedicated development team for hire?

The dedicated team model assumes you engage a group of professional developers who operate under your project management. At its core, a dedicated team serves as an extension of your in-house staff, ensuring your product’s success and being fully tailored to your business goals.

How to build a scalable dedicated team with Mobilunity?

To hire a dedicated software development team, drop us a few lines about your project requirements. We’ll call back to explore your project scope and future team composition and estimate its cost. Once agreed, we’ll proceed with finding, vetting, interviewing, and contracting your developers. You also have the flexibility to scale your team size and hire developers on the go.

Can we choose the members of our dedicated team?

Sure, we find the best candidates and send you their CVs, while you assess their technical expertise and manage the selection process.

How quickly can a dedicated software development team start working on the project once we decide to proceed?

Due to accessing the global talent pool and implementing best practices in tech recruiting, we provide exceptional dedicated development team services with the fastest turnaround time. It takes us, on average, 4.5 weeks to build a new dedicated team from the ground up or scale the team, while for some tech stacks, our recruiting process can be even faster. So if you’re looking to hire tech specialists urgently, we can help.

Do you provide a dedicated project manager?

Hiring a dedicated team with Mobilunity assumes you have a project manager in your in-house team or this specialist works on your project remotely. We focus solely on hiring experienced mid-level and senior developers without becoming your software development partner.

Are there any hidden costs when we hire dedicated developers?

Absolutely not. We ensure clarity and accountability by sharing that our price includes each employee’s salary, payroll taxes, sick leaves, vacations, office expenses, equipment and software, recruitment, HR, and retention fees.

What happens if we aren’t satisfied with a team member’s performance?

Should it happen that you’re not satisfied with the performance of any dedicated team member brought by Mobilunity during the trial period, we’ll identify the problem and try to fix it. Once it doesn’t work, we’ll replace the developer. You also can boost your team with additional training — we always leave the door open for continuous improvement when both sides of the deal win.

How do you protect our intellectual property and data when we hire dedicated software developers?

Mobilunity implements strict security measures, such as NDAs and contracts stating that all the code, designs, and software belong to the client. We also comply with security standards and we use encrypted connections, role-based access, VPNs, and more to prevent data exposure.
